title: Phantasmal Gardener
move_pattern: Cycles through moves in sequence: Bite → Lash → Flail → Enlarge (repeating). Starting move depends on combat slot position.
notes: The Phantasmal Gardener's size scales up with each Enlarge move used (formula: 1.0 + 0.1 × ln(EnlargeTriggers + 1)). It starts with different slot-based appearances (tall/short skins) and its visual scale affects attack animations. Skittish power determines different hit animations—extended hurt animation plays unless Skittish blocked damage that turn.
